name: Animatronic Performance Capture
author: pgianotto
description: Record a performer's head pose, facial expressions, and body movement. Play back through servos and export directly to FPP's sequence folder as an FSEQ v2 file.

privacy.summary: Records a performer's head, face and body movement from your camera as timed position values (not video) for servo playback or export. Recordings stay on this device until you delete them.

sends.what: a request for the face/body tracking model file (no personal or performance data)
sends.why: one-time download of MediaPipe's tracking model the first time tracking is used

collects.what: recorded head, face and body movement (position and timing values, not video)
collects.where: media/animations/ (manage or delete from the plugin's Record and Review tabs)

systemChanges.what: installs and enables the fpp-performance-capture systemd service running the capture daemon
writes /etc/apache2/conf-enabled/fpp-capture-proxy.conf, an Apache proxy route on FPP's web server
